text: Sherry Jones's The Jewel of Medina was cancelled by Random House ahead of its 2008 release, over concerns about possible inflammatory content. After the novel appeared in Serbia in August 2008, the Serbian publisher Beobook withdrew it from stores following strong reactions from the Serbian Muslim community, then returned it to shelves shortly after. The government banned the novel in Malaysia in 2009.
meta_description: Sherry Jones's The Jewel of Medina was cancelled by Random House in 2008, withdrawn and returned in Serbia, and banned by the government in Malaysia in 2009.
